A whitespace-only subscript keeps the word separator

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>A<sub> </sub>B</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
